notes.title: [Contest] Unleash your kinky creativity!
notes.content:
Calling all Commanders!

It’s time to let your imagination roam free and win some tasty treats!
Check out the prompt below, and continue the story and we’ll award the most original storyteller with awesome ingame prizes!

Prompt:
It’s hard to make a girl like Heather angry, but there are some things she doesn’t take lightly. As you watch her coming out of the forest, you can’t help but wonder...

What happens next? You decide!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38884948/c84bf160553e5195c09db17a34951c1d78c139c7.png

How this works: 

 Drop a comment in this post and continue the prompt with what you think happens next.
 The story should include at least one Heavy Metal Babes character, and be no longer than 10 sentences (of any length). 
 The lucky winner will be chosen randomly and will receive an ingame prize of 700 Gems
 One random player will be chosen at the end of the contest period. In order to receive the prize, you will have to provide your Steam ID (17-digit number) in the same comment as your submission. 
 The quiz will be available between 10th - 16th of May
 The winner will be announced on 17th of May


Don’t miss out! 
The Heavy Metal Babes team

notes.title: New Release Update 1.1.8
notes.content:
New release update 1.1.8

 Welcome to the 5AT1SFLY3R Units! Upgrade your XEN Skill levels directly!
 Fix SpeedDown Debuff.
 Fixed the problem in some evolved skills, not correctly applying all the damage sometimes.
 Skins are now available for all the units of the same class.
 Players can now Select the Evolved or Normal skins for the XEN units.
 Aster unit 3rd skill Defense Down is applied after the impacts.
 New characters enter into the supercube roster: Mist, Luna, Hana, Heather. Also a low prob. of getting Lotus.
 New items in the premium flirt chest: Shoes & Books.
 New XEN Lab will require less energy (apply for new XEN Labs).
 Other bug fixes.
